name: ICW International Championship
epitaph: Established as the promotion's primary singles title and put up in a sixteen-man tournament on its debut card; no champion is crowned within this record.

name: ICW Television Championship
epitaph: Established as the promotion's secondary singles title in its founding handbook; no contest for it survives in this record.

name: ICW International Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Ordered into being by the promotion's own commissioner after a post-match ambush on its debut card; the first match to crown a champion is scheduled for the following week, past the end of this record.
